scope: Reproduces the existing 121 model-driven attribute and collection results; no additional assertions, cases or platform coverage.

producer.change: Synchronous field-state snapshot and restoration helpers preserve the original operation and await order.

originalProducerControl.status: The original receipt remains HELD for blocked external operations; its complete source, result and restoration facts were reviewed separately.

comparison.results: Both independent native runs match the historical 121-result arrays exactly and are byte-identical to the unchanged public fixture.
comparison.postStateProjection: Only elapsedMs and sourceReads[].bodySha256 are omitted; values, metadata, inventories and dirty flags remain exact.
comparison.nativeDirtyState: The original and both refreshed runs retain the same entity/data and default-field dirty flags after value restoration; no pristine-form guarantee is added.

limits: Private source bodies, deployment and actor identities, browser state and ownership journals remain under ignored local evidence; they are not included here.
Existing authenticated browser contexts remain user-owned; only the recording pages were closed.
External POSTs were blocked and excluded, while explicitly reviewed UI startup operations remained allowed; no tested record saves or fixture mutations were performed.
Existing-context service-worker and WebSocket traffic is outside the page-routing guarantee.
Power Pages, other producers and historical capture provenance are unchanged.
